declared.question: whether gs, gt or gv needs a low-stack form through (ff), as d0 V did (#586), and which classes its gate must cover
declared.rule: per target and class, over both arches: a class's UNROLLED form is admissible when its stack is at most STACK_BUDGET_B = 14,000 B (#613's gradient-family budget) on sm_86 and on gfx1200 and its compile finishes within COMPILE_BUDGET_S = 300 s on both. A target with an inadmissible class gets a low-stack form gated by an la + lb floor, LOWSTACK_MIN_LSUM = the smallest la + lb with an inadmissible class: every class below it must be admissible (so stays unrolled, its text unchanged), every class at or above it is gated. Every low-stack unit must itself be within both budgets on both arches; where one is not, the form is changed, never the budget. A target with no inadmissible class keeps one form
declared.expected: gs and gt hold no Hermite density and fit everywhere; gv holds H0 and six derivative densities across its nucleus loop, so it is over budget from (df) (21 KB on sm_86 by hand) and at (ff) (50 KB), floor 5; the low-stack gv is the per-axis tables one index up and R, under 8 KB at (ff)
